card.label: H.R. 9497
card.summary: The Water Resources Development Act of 2026 authorizes, modifies, and directs water resource infrastructure projects and programs managed by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers. The bill covers feasibility studies for navigation, flood risk management, ecosystem restoration, and water supply; establishes new offices within the Corps; sets guidelines for dredging, environmental remediation, and project delivery; deauthorizes certain inactive projects; and authorizes numerous environmental infrastructure and local assistance projects nationwide.
